notes: v3.0.30 - Pulls finish their own visit notes. A day pull that ends with only unread encounter bodies now completes them automatically (up to two extra passes) without ever taking your screen - nothing is focused, moved, or resized, on Windows or Mac. And with Full visit notes off, the pull still saves the pulled day's own encounter note, so op-note prep for that visit always has it; every other row is indexed honestly and counted as deliberately skipped on the receipt. Requires Chrome 116+.
